target_definition.metric: United States two-year Treasury yield monthly change

graph_diagnosis.summary: Inflation, economic resilience, Federal Reserve communication, policy repricing, and fiscal-inflation risk provide a reusable two-year yield framework.
weaknesses: Realized long-yield movements, option links, and target-period resolution proxies are excluded.
Later-period anchors make the bridge indirect and weak; current verification is required.

search_factors.why_search: Persistent inflation can delay further easing.
Resilient activity can support a cautious policy path.
Fed communication shapes expected short rates.
Policy proposals can affect inflation and term-risk expectations.

checkpoints.mechanism: Inflation above target can sustain caution about easing.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Inflation breadth and policy communication agree.

checkpoints.mechanism: Resilient activity can reinforce a cautious policy stance.
A cautious policy path can support expected short rates.
Fiscal-inflation risk can lift rate expectations even as policy rates ease.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Inflation expectations and Treasury risk pricing rise together.

checkpoints.factor: Expected policy path into two-year yields
checkpoints.mechanism: Inflation, activity, policy repricing, and fiscal-inflation risk combine to determine two-year yield direction.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Verify current inflation, labor and activity data, FOMC communication, rate futures, and Treasury risk pricing.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Two-year yields diverge from current repricing.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Persistent inflation and resilient activity can support a cautious expected policy path.
Fiscal-inflation risk can counter an easing-policy narrative.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Easing expectations outweigh persistent inflation risk.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare rate futures with inflation and activity surprises.

forecast_audit_questions: Is fiscal risk affecting Treasury pricing?
